offboarding.title: Offboarding
offboarding.subtitle: People who are leaving, and their hand-over before the last day
offboarding.startIntro: Marks them as leaving and creates their hand-over checklist. They're terminated automatically the day after their last working day.
offboarding.noticeHint: {{ count }} days from today. Tasks are spread across that time.
offboarding.pastBody: Their employment ends as soon as you start the offboarding.
offboarding.reasonHint: Kept on their record when they leave.
offboarding.emptyBody: Start an offboarding when someone resigns or their contract ends.
offboarding.historyEmptyBody: Completed and cancelled offboardings show up here.
offboarding.pastLastDayHint: Past their last day, tasks still open
offboarding.lastDayIn: Last day in {{ count }} days — {{ date }}
offboarding.settlementHint: Leave balances and overtime rates aren't tracked yet, so they're not in the total.
offboarding.completedBody: Every task on {{ name }}'s checklist is done.
offboarding.cancelBody: They go back to the status they had before. This can't be undone.
offboarding.cancelBodyAfter: Their last day has passed, so they stay terminated — reinstate them from their profile if needed. Only the checklist closes.
